# Concurrency Checklist: ISK-0010 — System-Operator Bootstrap & Security Baseline

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for single-use tokens, the forward-only installation state, supersession, and replica behavior are complete, unambiguous, and measurable across concurrent callers and replicas
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Single use

- [x] CHK001 - Is "exactly one succeeds" stated for any number of callers across any number of processes on one database, and for a consumed token thereafter? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Redemption 2]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the serialization point of concurrent redemptions of one token named, with what a waiter observes after the holder commits? [Completeness, Research R5]
- [x] CHK003 - Is it stated how two different bootstrap tokens that are both briefly valid cannot both initialize the installation? [Coverage, Research R5]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the outcome of a redemption racing a supersede of the same token defined by the reason-class order, with no third outcome? [Coverage, Contract §Redemption 3, Plan §Risks]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the outcome defined for a bootstrap token issued while a redemption of an earlier token is committing? [Edge Case, Contract §Redemption 3, Research R6]
- [x] CHK006 - Is AV-2 (no advisory lock or coordinator for redemption) stated with how the plan validates it? [Assumption, Spec §AV-2, Research R5]

## Issuing and supersession

- [x] CHK007 - Is "at most one active token per purpose" made enforceable by the database, not only by the issuing code? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Tokens 4]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the behavior of two concurrent issues of one purpose specified, including the bound on waiting and the failure beyond it? [Completeness, Contract §Tokens 6, Research R6]
- [x] CHK009 - Is it stated that a token is printed only after its row is durable, so a lost commit shows nothing? [Clarity, Container §Bootstrap command 4, Research R6]

## State and time

- [x] CHK010 - Is the forward-only rule for the installation state stated and enforced below the application? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Persistence §Isolation 11]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the caching rule for replicas stated in both directions (may keep `initialized`, never `uninitialized` or unknown)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Contract §Installation state 4]
- [x] CHK012 - Is expiry measured by one clock, so replicas' clocks cannot disagree about it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Research R5]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the handling of an unknown commit outcome specified, with no automatic retry and a defined next step for the operator? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Redemption 8]
- [x] CHK014 - Is a request arriving during start, before composition finishes, given a defined answer? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Limits and enrollment

- [x] CHK015 - Is the attempt limiter's scope (per host instance, never static, shared by both routes) stated so two embedded hosts in one process do not share it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Research R8]
- [x] CHK016 - Is enrollment consumption required to be atomic and once-only for its bound principal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011a, Contract §Enrollment 2]

## Measurability

- [x] CHK017 - Is the concurrency acceptance quantified (callers, hosts, runs) with the attempt limit set so no attempt is limited, and the limit tested separately? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §FR-043, §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Review 2026-11-21, first pass: CHK008 failed, because the contract did not say what happens when an issuer waits past the advisory lock's 5-second bound. The contract's Tokens rule 6 now states the bound and that the issuer fails with `persistence.lock_timeout`, exits 5, and prints nothing (persistence contract, Advisory locks rule 3). Re-reviewed and passed.
